general_world_news.title: 🌍 World News
general_world_news.content:
• **United States/Donald Trump:** Donald Trump was inaugurated as the 47th President of the United States on January 20, 2025, at the US Capitol in Washington, D.C. He immediately signed an executive order to implement a 10% baseline tariff on all imports from China to reduce the trade deficit. The S&P 500 saw a 1.2% dip in the hours following the announcement as companies feared increased costs. This move signals a shift toward aggressive protectionism that disrupts global trade norms. Reuters

• **India/Narendra Modi:** Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a formal phone call with President Donald Trump on January 21, 2025, to discuss strategic defense partnerships. The two leaders agreed to accelerate the delivery of GE F414 jet engines to India as part of a revised defense procurement timeline. The Indian Ministry of External Affairs released a statement emphasizing a "strengthened strategic bond." This cooperation strengthens the Quad's efforts to counterbalance Chinese influence in the Indo-Pacific. AP

• **European Union/Ursula von der Leyen:** European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen convened an emergency meeting of the European Council in Brussels on January 20, 2025, to discuss a coordinated response to the new US tariff regime. The council discussed the creation of a "strategic autonomy fund" totaling 50 billion euros to support EU industries affected by trade volatility. Germany and France emerged as the primary backers of the fund, while smaller member states expressed concern over the funding mechanism. The move reflects the EU's attempt to insulate its economy from US political volatility. Financial Times

Why it matters: The start of the new US administration is triggering an immediate global realignment of trade policies and strategic alliances.
